concerns.text: T010 and T010a introduce a 'synthetic fallback' that automatically triggers in CI if real data is missing. This violates Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) and FR-001 (System MUST download... LSMS-ISA). The task defines a deliverable (synthetic data) that falls short of the FR's requirement for real data, creating a semantic weakening where the pipeline passes CI without ever validating the real data ingestion logic against the actual source.

T025 implements Cluster-Robust SEs only if the dataset is 'not aggregated'. However, the Spec (Edge Cases) and Plan (Complexity Tracking) mandate village-level aggregation when N < 300. If the dataset is aggregated to the village level, the 'village_id' becomes a unique identifier for every row, making clustering by 'village_id' statistically invalid (singular matrix). The task fails to specify the required fallback to Huber-White (robust) SEs for the aggregated case, violating the statistical rigor required by FR-004.

T030 requires re-computing NDVI time-series for each cloud cover threshold {0.6, 0.7, 0.8} from raw granules. The Plan (Compute Feasibility) and Spec (Assumptions) explicitly constrain execution to a CPU-only runner with limited RAM and a 6-hour time limit. Re-processing the entire satellite time-series multiple times from raw data without an intermediate caching strategy for the NDVI time-series (only the raw granules are cached per T016) creates a high risk of violating the compute constraints, effectively weakening the feasibility requirement.

T070-T073 are marked as unchecked `[ ]` but are listed in the 'Dependencies & Execution Order' as 'mandatory to satisfy the Creativity Review' before final submission. This creates a logical contradiction where the project cannot be submitted as complete while these critical novelty tasks remain unstarted. The task list fails to preserve the 'mandatory' constraint from the plan, effectively allowing a submission that violates the project's own completion criteria.

T002 and T046 are marked as 'REJECTED' or incomplete in the 'Analyze Report' context (implied by the CRITICAL severity note in the prompt's 'Analyze Report' section, though the task text itself shows `[X]`). If the artifacts (`state/...yaml`, test skeletons) are missing, T015-T022 (US1) and T025 (US2) depend on non-existent foundations. The task list presents a dependency chain that cannot execute, violating the 'feasibility' constraint of the plan.
